## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link any related issue.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Distinguish synthetic fixtures from tests with an installed extension and a real AniList account. Note any checks not performed.

## Review notes

Include relevant data/lifecycle effects, documentation changes, remaining limitations and redacted screenshots for visible changes. Omit sections that do not apply. Do not attach tokens, private archives or raw storage.
